name: Hollowmere: The Prince at the Chapel Steps

factions.name: House Aldreth
factions.ideology: The sea feeds Hollowmere. Those who build and sail its ships built this town, and the harbour must not answer to the plough.

factions.name: House Corvane
factions.ideology: Bread outlasts trade. The land and the mills fed Hollowmere through every famine, and no harbour lord may set himself above the fields.

factions.name: The Unaligned
factions.ideology: Law, medicine, and mercy serve the town, not a house. They hold beliefs, and they carry gossip, but they take no side.

agents.name: Prince Edryc Aldreth
agents.summary: The Aldreth heir, found dead at the chapel steps before dawn. He had spent his last week quietly auditing the granary accounts.

agents.name: Lady Maren Aldreth
agents.summary: Edryc's younger sister and now the heir of House Aldreth. Grieving in public, calculating in private, and unsure whether she wants justice or advantage.

agents.name: Tobias Reeve
agents.summary: Harbourmaster. Keeps the tide tables and the ledgers, and believes any death has a paper trail if you look hard enough.

agents.name: Sella Dorn
agents.summary: Master shipwright. Loyal to the House that pays her yard, and quick to read insult into any Corvane word.

agents.name: Garrick Vell
agents.summary: Shipwright and Sella's rival for the yard. Would happily see her discredited, which makes him unusually willing to believe bad news.

agents.name: Ilsa Kenner
agents.summary: Ropemaker. Hears everything in the yard and repeats most of it, usually improved.

agents.name: Bram Atwell
agents.summary: Dockhand with a bad shoulder and a long memory for slights from the mill road.

agents.name: Ned Quilley
agents.summary: Dockhand. Cheerful, credulous, and the fastest route from the quay to the tavern for any piece of news.

agents.name: Oriel Faskin
agents.summary: Sailmaker. Sews in silence, listens closely, and speaks only when she is certain — which makes people believe her.

agents.name: Perrin Slate
agents.summary: Cooper. Supplies barrels to both the harbour and the granary, so he is trusted by neither side entirely.

agents.name: Wyn Thatcher
agents.summary: Fishwife with the loudest stall in the square. What she says at dawn is what the town believes by dusk.

agents.name: Caleb Mord
agents.summary: Ferryman. Was on the water the night the prince died and has not said what he saw.

agents.name: Annet Pike
agents.summary: Netmender. Widowed young, sharp with money, and the person others go to when they want a rumour tested.

agents.name: Rusk Baelen
agents.summary: Customs clerk. Knows exactly which cargoes never appeared in the ledgers, and knows what that knowledge is worth.

agents.name: Jory Vance
agents.summary: Shipyard apprentice, sixteen and desperate to matter. Repeats whatever the older hands say, louder.

agents.name: Fen Marrow
agents.summary: Lamplighter. Walks every street after dark and therefore sees more of Hollowmere at night than anyone alive.

agents.name: Lord Alric Corvane
agents.summary: Head of House Corvane. Old, land-proud, and genuinely uncertain whether his own son had a hand in the prince's death.

agents.name: Rowan Corvane
agents.summary: Alric's son. Was seen near the quay the night of the death and refuses to explain why, which he considers a matter of honour and everyone else considers guilt.

agents.name: Mabel Thorn
agents.summary: Head miller. Runs the Great Mill and considers the harbour a parasite on honest grain.

agents.name: Osric Gale
agents.summary: Second miller. Devout, anxious, and inclined to read a death at the chapel steps as judgement rather than murder.

agents.name: Dunstan Reed
agents.summary: Tenant farmer. Owes the Corvanes more than he can repay, so his loyalty is not entirely voluntary.

agents.name: Tamsin Vye
agents.summary: Farmer. Lost a brother to a harbour brawl years ago and has never let it go.

agents.name: Cuthbert Ash
agents.summary: Granary keeper. The prince was auditing his books the week he died, a fact Cuthbert would prefer stayed quiet.

agents.name: Edda Lyle
agents.summary: Baker. Everyone in Hollowmere passes her counter each morning, and she remembers what each of them said.

agents.name: Silas Wren
agents.summary: Carter. Hauls grain to the quay daily and is therefore the main conduit of gossip between the two houses.

agents.name: Petra Holm
agents.summary: Dairymaid. Young, sharp-eyed, and quietly courting a shipwright, which she cannot afford anyone to learn.

agents.name: Gideon Stack
agents.summary: Thresher. Enormous, slow to anger, and the man both sides would want holding a cudgel if it came to that.

agents.name: Lark Penn
agents.summary: Shepherd. Spends days alone above the fields and comes down with strange certainties nobody can source.

agents.name: Bertram Croy
agents.summary: Blacksmith. Shoes horses for both houses and has lately been asked to forge things he would rather not describe.

agents.name: Iris Fenn
agents.summary: Weaver. Sells in the square, listens to both sides, and has grown skilled at agreeing with whoever is in front of her.

agents.name: Hollis Barrow
agents.summary: Corvane steward. Manages the House's affairs and would burn a ledger before letting it reach the magistrate.

agents.name: Clem Ottery
agents.summary: Stablehand at High Row. Sees which nobles ride out at night and to where, and has not yet realised what that is worth.

agents.name: Magistrate Veranne Thule
agents.summary: The town magistrate. Legally obliged to find the truth, politically obliged to survive whichever house wins.

agents.name: Father Ansel
agents.summary: Chapel priest. Found the body. Preaches restraint to a town that is rapidly losing interest in restraint.

agents.name: Ambrose Kyte
agents.summary: Physician. Examined the prince's body and recorded a cause of death he is no longer willing to repeat aloud.

agents.name: Hester Lowe
agents.summary: Keeps The Drowned Bell. Serves both houses, hears every version of every story, and sells none of them cheaply.

agents.name: Widow Sable
agents.summary: Has outlived three husbands and every previous scandal in Hollowmere. Treats a good rumour as a civic duty.

agents.name: Coran Pell
agents.summary: Town crier. Whatever reaches him becomes official, which is a great deal of power for a man who does not check.

agents.name: Morna Dell
agents.summary: Herbalist. Sold a sleeping draught the week the prince died and has been counting her jars ever since.

agents.name: Jenna Ryle
agents.summary: An orphan of eleven who goes everywhere unnoticed and consequently knows more than any adult in Hollowmere.

claims.text: House Corvane ordered the prince's killing to stop his audit of the granary.
claims.subject: alric_corvane

claims.text: Rowan Corvane was seen near the quay the night the prince died.
claims.subject: rowan_corvane

claims.text: The prince died of a wasting sickness, and there was never any blade at all.
claims.subject: edryc_aldreth

claims.text: Lady Maren welcomed her brother's death and moved on the inheritance within the day.
claims.subject: maren_aldreth

claims.text: The physician was paid to leave the wound out of his record.
claims.subject: ambrose_kyte

claims.text: The granary books have been falsified for years, and the prince had found it.
claims.subject: cuthbert_ash

claims.text: The millers have been mixing blight into the grain sold to the harbour.
claims.subject: mabel_thorn

claims.text: The shipyard has been landing arms by night for House Aldreth.
claims.subject: sella_dorn

claims.text: The magistrate already knows who did it and is protecting them.
claims.subject: veranne_thule

claims.text: The ferryman was on the water that night and saw who came down to the steps.
claims.subject: caleb_mord

effects.description: The prince is laid to rest beneath the chapel. Neither House sends word to the other.
Fire takes the eastern granary before dawn. Nobody will say who was seen leaving it.
Magistrate Thule opens a formal inquiry and summons both Houses to the plaza.
Lady Maren Aldreth is killed. Whatever the cause, the harbour will not hear of an inquiry now.
Lord Alric Corvane is killed. The millfields arm themselves before the body is cold.

opening.description: Prince Edryc Aldreth is found dead at the foot of the chapel steps before dawn. Father Ansel will say only that the body was cold when he reached it.
